summary: Implemented the governed TypeScript Railway backend, including the current PatientTransportSummary command identity/version across memory and PostgreSQL projection paths so Maria can perform a guarded acknowledgment without widening caregiver data.

commands: npx vitest run tests/server/domain.test.ts tests/server/repository.test.ts tests/server/security.test.ts tests/server/security-remediation.test.ts
python3 scripts/agentctl.py scope check LAUNCH-001 backend
npm run build:server && npm run test:server && npm run test:security
Scratch PostgreSQL 17: run npm run migrate:server twice against a fresh database and inspect public.oncoready_schema_migrations
tests.notes: The final-review repair passed build/typecheck plus 36 targeted domain, repository, security, and security-remediation tests. New coverage proves PatientTransportSummary exposes the current transport_request_id and aggregate_version after seed/creation/transitions, PostgreSQL reads reconcile them from the relational transport projection, patient acknowledgment rejects stale versions, wrong state, and disallowed claimed roles, a valid patient acknowledgment updates all four role projections, caregiver minimization excludes command identity/version, and completion still requires picked_up plus nonblank closure evidence. Earlier integrated evidence remains 48 focused server/contract/FHIR tests, 18 security/webhook tests, validated contracts, and six vendor-neutral migration tests.

notes_for_next_agent: Configure the Railway api service to use railway/api.toml, the repository root as build context, one replica, sleeping disabled, and DATABASE_URL=${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}. Railway now runs npm run migrate:server as the pre-deploy command after the compiled server build.

The migration runner sorts database/migrations/*.sql lexically, holds a PostgreSQL advisory lock, requires applied history to be an exact prefix, rejects checksum drift before running new SQL, and records each migration transactionally in public.oncoready_schema_migrations without logging connection values.

The process listens on 0.0.0.0:$PORT, exposes database-backed GET /health, runs the same WorkflowApplication.tick cycle from the internal scheduler and authenticated manual endpoint, and waits for an active tick before closing PostgreSQL on SIGTERM/SIGINT.

Public access is enabled only by ONCOREADY_PUBLIC_DEMO_ENABLED=true and is fixed to the illustrative finals scenario. Public reads and commands require no browser credential, while application/repository effect classes prevent every public command from creating provider outbox authorization.

Keep ONCOREADY_OPERATOR_TOKEN server-only. Reset and fixed-recipient SMS/voice initiation require X-OncoReady-Operator-Token; accepted communication outbox payloads persist authorization_source=operator_control before the existing provider switches and allowlists are evaluated.

Reset-seeded and future cadence scheduled_actions remain internal/manual workflow records. A due schedule is rejected with operator_authorization_required and never becomes an outbox row; only an operator communication command creates provider intent.

Before dispatch, PostgreSQL verifies authorization_source=operator_control, a matching communication_id/stable_action_id, and a linked communication.queued workflow event for the same scenario/channel. Legacy or malformed outbox rows are failed without network I/O.
Public PostgreSQL hosts require sslmode=require, verify-ca, or verify-full. Localhost and Railway private *.railway.internal connections remain supported without a TLS query flag.

CRON_SECRET is validated during startup and manual-tick preflight as at least 32 UTF-8 bytes with at least 128 estimated bits of character-distribution entropy; weak or repetitive values fail with dependency_unavailable.

Readiness is patient/web-only. Work-item and transport commands enforce resource existence, supported resource type, action, current-state, and claimed-role policies. CareLink request creation accepts only work_item_id plus command context and derives the fixed plan from server-owned finals state.

Patient transport summaries carry the current transport_request_id and aggregate_version from seed through CareLink creation and transitions. PostgreSQL patient reads reconcile identity/version from transport_projections; caregiver minimization intentionally excludes both fields.

Maria may acknowledge only the current patient_notified request using actor_role=patient and the current aggregate version. The transition updates coordinator, staff, patient, and caregiver projections while preserving the picked_up plus nonblank closure-evidence completion guard.

Provider intent is committed before network I/O. Unknown network outcomes become outcome_unknown and are excluded from blind re-claim; signed callbacks reconcile stored attempts by provider conversation/message reference.

ElevenLabs callbacks accept the official signed post_call_transcription and call_initiation_failure envelopes, derive scenario/correlation only from stored provider attempts, return HTTP 200, and persist neither transcript nor audio.

Keep EXTERNAL_ACTIONS_ENABLED, TWILIO_SMS_ENABLED, and ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ENABLED false until Railway variables, fixed recipient, exact public origin, and signed callback preflight pass. No live provider action was performed by this worker.
